messages.text:
Hello,

I'm writing under Article 17 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) to ask you to erase all personal data you hold about me that is linked to the email address (email hidden) That includes any Moken (moken.io) account or sign-up.

This request covers Helium, Moken, and every subsidiary, affiliate and partner of theirs that received or processed my data. Please also pass it on to any processor or third party you shared my data with, as Article 19 requires.

Please:
1. Delete any account, profile, wallet links, usage and marketing data tied to this address.
2. Remove the address from all mailing and marketing lists.
3. Confirm in writing once the erasure is done, and tell me which subsidiaries, affiliates or partners you passed the request on to.

If you need to keep any data by law, please tell me what it is, the legal basis, and how long you'll keep it.

Under Article 12(3) you have one month to respond. Please reply to this address.

Kind regards,
Brendan D.
Handed to the team · Data erasure/privacy request, outside my tools and requires a legal/data decisio

Hello Brendan,

Thanks for your message, and for setting it out so clearly.

A request like this is handled by our team directly rather than by me, so I have passed it to them with your email address, the details of what you have asked for, and the Article 12(3) deadline noted. They pick it up today at 10am Eastern and will reply to this address.

They will be the ones to confirm what has been erased, what if anything has to be retained and on what legal basis, and which parties the request was passed on to. I am not going to guess at any of that here, because it needs to come from the people who can actually check it and confirm it in writing.

Your request is logged as of today, so the clock starts from now.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Sarah and team,

I am following up on my Article 17 erasure request of 4 November 2026 for the address (email hidden), covering Helium, Moken, and their affiliates. Thank you for acknowledging it the same day and passing it to the team.

I would be grateful for a status update, and for written confirmation once the erasure is complete. If you need to keep any data by law, please tell me what it is, the legal basis, and how long you will keep it.

Kind regards,
Brendan D.
Handed to the team · Customer is chasing the GDPR erasure request raised on 4 November; no outcome ha

Hello Brendan,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you have had to.

I do not have a completion to report to you yet, and I am not going to tell you it is done when I cannot see that it is. I have put your request back in front of the team this morning with the original date of 4 November, so they have it as a live item rather than an acknowledged one. They are back at 10am Eastern today and will reply to this address.

What you will get from them is the written confirmation you asked for: what has been erased across Helium and Moken, which processors and partners the request was passed on to under Article 19, and if anything has to be retained, what it is, the legal basis and how long it will be held. Your removal from marketing lists is part of that same confirmation.

Your Article 12(3) deadline runs from 4 November and is noted on the request, so there is time, but you should not need to chase it again.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
